what: What a system of SRAM-resident LOGOS decode chips must achieve to beat a GPU deployment's FLOOR (its memory roofline with every overhead at zero) by the speedup, per user at batch one. Each requirement is a pair of latency budgets: the most one dependent stage may take on chip with chip-to-chip hops free, and the most one chip-to-chip hop may take at the design's own on-chip stage latency. `demonstrated` is the per-stage latency a vendor's published per-user rate implies, the yardstick for a budget. Regenerate with `cargo run -p logicaffeine-compile --example decode_chip_report`; spatial_decode_chip_lock holds the file to the model.
